title: Tactical Scene, Lighting, Fog, Elevation & Hazard Authoring
objective: Implement tactical-map authoring for grid calibration, measurement/templates, spawn/waypoint zones, cover/elevation annotations, hazard/light inputs, wall/door occlusion geometry and fog painting/preview while keeping runtime LOS, collision, cover, movement and hazard adjudication with Scene/Combat/Visibility owners.

scope.purpose: Provide tactical-scene cartographic authoring and preview over completed MCS map foundations without becoming runtime Scene/Combat/Visibility adjudication authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative tactical documents can deterministically author and inspect grid calibration, measurements/templates, spawn/waypoint zones, cover/elevation annotations, hazard/light inputs, wall/door occlusion geometry and fog presentation while runtime LOS, collision, cover, movement and hazard adjudication remain Scene/Combat/Visibility owner authority.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 and MCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json schema 0.3.0 were reconsulted after MCS-14 exact-tree publication. No cross-program rotation detour supersedes the surviving MCS strict order, so MCS-15 is selected.
MCS-15 is a tactical-map authoring and preview seam over completed MCS foundations.

Square/hex/gridless calibration, measurement/templates, spawn/waypoint zones, cover/elevation annotations, hazard/light inputs, wall/door occlusion geometry and fog painting/preview remain cartographic authoring/projection state.
Runtime LOS, collision, cover, movement and hazard adjudication remain with Scene/Combat/Visibility owners and are not inferred or executed by MCS-15.
MCS-15 is governed-started on branch work/mcs-15-tactical-scene-authoring from application main 99663044e1c2463e95787d50932df7edfe58d834; implementation authority is limited to this bounded tranche.
MCS-18, PCA-16, MCCS, MRCS, MSAS, MNCS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized by this selection.
next_action: Remain selected_not_started and do not execute while UISR is current. Resume through operations/CURRENT.json only after UISR-10 terminal closeout or a later explicit owner reprioritization.
